column1: Pick the basil leaves and place them in ice water.
Put the garlic and a few grains of sea salt in a mortar and crush with the pestle until creamy.
Drain the basil, shake it clean and dry, then add it to the mortar with another pinch of salt.
Crush the basil with a pound-and-twist motion against the sides of the mortar until it releases a bright green liquid and forms a paste.
Add the Parmesan and Pecorino and work them in.
Add the pine nuts and pound until incorporated and creamy.
Slowly pour in the olive oil while stirring with the pestle until smooth and creamy.
